info.title: Jatri API
info.description: Flight, bus and train ticket booking for Bangladesh. All responses use the `{success, data, error}` envelope.

delete.description:
In-app account deletion (Google Play requirement). Personal data is removed; bookings that
must be kept for accounting will be anonymised here once they exist (Phase 3+).

post.description: Results are cached for a few minutes; live price and seats are re-checked at booking time.

One-way (1 slice), round trip (2) or multi-city (up to 4). Cached a few minutes; prices are
re-checked live on the offer details screen and again at booking time.

get.description: Live price, fare rules and baggage for one offer. `offer_expired` (409) if it's gone.

post.description:
Trains for one day, with seats left and fare per class. Only dates up to 10 days ahead
(`outside_sale_window` otherwise); trains on their weekly off day are left out.

get.description: Coaches of one class with their seat maps; seats someone else is paying for show as `held`.

post.description:
Holds the seats (bus, train) or the fare (flight, with a PNR) for `hold_minutes` (status `held`).
`mode` picks the body shape. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a retried request returns the
same booking instead of holding twice.

get.description: Newest first, all modes (My Trips splits them into upcoming, completed and cancelled).
What cancelling now would give back (refund), keep (fee) and why, before the user confirms.

post.description:
An unpaid hold is released. A ticket is cancelled with the provider by its quote (send
`expected_refund` from the quote; `refund_changed` if it moved), and the refund is started.
Starts a payment for a held booking and returns the gateway page to open in a browser tab.
Server-to-server notification from the gateway (IPN). This, not the app, decides if a payment succeeded.

expected_refund.title: Expected Refund

change_fee.title: Change Fee
